title: sliderCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Slider COMP instances, covering the operator-specific click() method for one-dimensional and UV sliders plus inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs to simulate a Slider COMP click to update panel U, V, or UV state.
If one value is provided, it updates the slider's primary coordinate: U for U sliders and V for V sliders.
Use two normalized coordinates to update both U and V on a UV slider.
Use vOnly=True when one coordinate is supplied to a UV slider and only the V coordinate should change.
Use force carefully because it can click the slider even when it is disabled; specify left, middle, or right when the default left-button event is not the target.
